title: Email/Password Authentication Success
description: Verify that a user can successfully authenticate using valid email and password credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-in screen.
Input valid email and password.
Click the sign-in button.
Check that authentication is successful and the JWT token is stored securely.
Verify user is redirected to the appropriate home screen based on role.

title: Google Sign-In Authentication Success
description: Verify that a user can successfully authenticate using Google Sign-In and a JWT token is securely stored.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-in screen.
Click on the Google Sign-In button and complete authentication flow.
Verify authentication is successful and JWT token is stored securely.
Confirm user is redirected to the correct home screen depending on user role.

title: Authentication Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Ensure authentication fails and appropriate error messages are displayed when using invalid email or password.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-in screen.
Input invalid email and/or password.
Click the sign-in button.
Check that authentication fails and relevant error message is displayed to user.

title: Actor Home Screen Casting List Display and Search
description: Verify that the actor home screen displays casting listings correctly and search function returns accurate filtered results.

steps.description: Log in as an actor user.
Confirm casting list is populated with available castings.
Enter a search term related to casting titles or locations.
Verify the displayed casting list filters correctly based on the search term.

title: Casting Creation by Agency
description: Verify that an agency can create a new casting with valid information and submit it successfully.

steps.description: Log in as an agency user.
Navigate to the casting creation screen.
Input all required casting details including title, description, location, date, and media uploads.
Submit the casting creation form.
Confirm casting is successfully created and appears in agency's casting list.

title: Casting Application by Actor
description: Test the actor's ability to apply for a casting and verify application status updates correctly.

steps.description: Log in as an actor user.
Navigate to a casting detail screen.
Submit an application for the casting.
Verify application is recorded and status is updated in 'My Candidatures' screen.

title: Casting List Filtering Functionalities
description: Validate that filtering options on casting lists work correctly for actors and agencies.

steps.description: Log in as actor or agency.
Apply various filters such as date range, location, type of casting, or status.
Verify the casting list updates to show only items matching the filter criteria.

title: Agenda Interview Scheduling for Agency
description: Ensure agencies can schedule interviews with actors via the agenda and that updates are synchronized.

steps.description: Log in as an agency user.
Navigate to the agenda or interview scheduling screen.
Select casting and actor, pick date and time for interview.
Confirm interview scheduling.
Verify interview appears correctly in agenda calendar for agency and actor.

title: Profile Update Functionalities for Actors and Agencies
description: Verify users can update profile information and settings correctly with persistence across sessions.

steps.description: Log in as an actor user.
Navigate to profile management screen.
Modify profile details including name, contact info, and media uploads.
Save changes.
Verify updated information is persisted and displays correctly upon app restart.
Repeat steps for agency user profile management.

title: AI Chatbot Interaction for Agencies
description: Test chatbot conversation flows with AI technologies Gemini and Groq, checking message sending and response accuracy.

steps.description: Log in as an agency user.
Navigate to the AI Chatbot screen.
Send a set of queries to the chatbot.
Verify that the chatbot responds appropriately and messages display without delay.

title: AI Training Module Functionality for Actors
description: Ensure actors can initiate AI training sessions and receive feedback within the training module.

steps.description: Log in as an actor user.
Navigate to AI Training screen.
Start a training session and interact with training content.
Verify training session completes and feedback is provided correctly.

title: Favorites Management for Actors
description: Validate that actors can add or remove casting listings to their favorites and that favorites are persisted.

steps.description: Log in as an actor user.
Navigate to a casting listing.
Add the casting to favorites.
Confirm the casting appears in the favorites list.
Remove the casting from favorites.
Verify the casting is removed from favorites and this change persists across app sessions.

title: Interactive Map Casting Location Accuracy
description: Verify that the interactive map correctly displays casting locations geographically for all castings.

steps.description: Log in as any user.
Navigate to the interactive map screen.
Confirm that castings are accurately represented by map markers according to their location data.
Use map zoom and pan functionalities.
Verify map remains responsive and markers update accordingly.

title: Password Reset Flow with Email Validation
description: Ensure users can request password reset emails and complete password reset successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the password reset request screen.
Input registered email address and submit request.
Verify that password reset email is sent.
Use the link or token from email to navigate to reset password screen.
Input new password and confirm password.
Submit password reset form.
Verify password is successfully reset and user can log in with new password.

title: Media Uploads: Photos, Videos, PDFs
description: Validate that the media upload functionality works correctly for photos, videos, and PDF files during casting creation and profile editing.

steps.description: Log in as actor or agency user.
Navigate to casting creation screen or profile editing screen.
Attach photo, video, and PDF files using media upload controls.
Submit the form with uploads.
Verify that media uploads complete without data loss or corruption and appear correctly in UI.

title: Role-Based Navigation Bar Functionality
description: Verify that navigation bars are correctly displayed and functional for actors and agencies with respective role access.

steps.description: Log in as actor user and observe navigation bar.
Confirm navigation bar contains actor-specific screens and navigation works properly.
Log out and log in as agency user.
Confirm navigation bar contains agency-specific screens and all navigations function without errors.

title: API Client Retrofit Configuration and Error Handling
description: Test that API calls use Retrofit correctly with secure interceptors and handle errors gracefully with appropriate user feedback.

steps.description: Perform actions that trigger various API calls (e.g., login, casting creation, profile update).
Check the Retrofit client attaches valid JWT tokens in request headers.
Simulate API errors like 401 Unauthorized, 404 Not Found, and 500 Server Errors.
Verify error interceptors handle these errors properly and display user-friendly error messages.

title: Sign-Up Flow Validation for Actor and Agency
description: Validate multi-step sign-up processes for actor and agency users including data input validation and successful account creation.

steps.description: Navigate to sign-up screen and select actor sign-up.
Complete all required sign-up steps with valid data.
Verify account is created successfully and user can log in afterwards.
Repeat flow for agency sign-up and verify similar success.
Provide invalid or incomplete data in sign-up forms.
Check that validation errors are displayed clearly and prevent submission.

title: Media Upload Edge Case: Large File Handling and Unsupported Formats
description: Verify that the media upload feature handles large file sizes and rejects unsupported formats correctly with meaningful errors.

steps.description: Attempt to upload a very large photo, video, or PDF file beyond size limits.
Verify upload is rejected and appropriate error message about file size is displayed.
Attempt to upload unsupported file formats.
Verify upload is rejected and user sees clear error indicating unsupported format.

title: Session Expiry and Token Refresh Handling
description: Ensure the app responds correctly when the JWT token expires, prompting user to re-authenticate or refresh token without data loss.

steps.description: Authenticate and obtain valid JWT token.
Simulate token expiry during an API call.
Verify app prompts user to re-authenticate or refreshes token automatically if supported.
Ensure no unsaved data is lost and user experience is seamless.
